title: Card Relationship Levels and the Cover a Personal Checking Protection Source Must Provide
content:
**Clause.** The cover a protection source must provide for a Personal Checking account moves with the owner's card payments under Personal Credit Cards and with the balances the owner holds under Savings & Money Market Accounts.

1. Where the owner has made at least 6 card payments in the last twelve months **and** the owner's premier money market balance reaches the protection source minimum of 5000.00, the cover a source must provide is a light cover requirement of 250.00.
2. Where the case above does not apply **and** either the owner has made at least 3 card payments in the last twelve months **or** the owner holds any statement savings balance at all, it is a standard cover requirement of 1500.00.
3. Where neither case applies, neither of those lighter requirements is used.

**Worked requirements on hypothetical inputs.**

| Owner's position | Cover a source must provide |
|---|---|
| 8 card payments in the last twelve months, premier money market balance of 9000.00 | 250.00 |
| 8 card payments, premier money market balance of 400.00 | 1500.00, the card payment limb of the second case being met |
| 1 card payment, statement savings balance of 60.00 | 1500.00 |
| 1 card payment, no statement savings balance | Neither of those requirements is used |

The first case requires both of its limbs; the second is met by either limb alone, and any statement savings balance above zero satisfies its second limb. Equality satisfies each threshold, so exactly 6 card payments with a premier money market balance of exactly 5000.00 reaches the first case.
